comparison_bar_note: the plan compares fp16's p90 against the crop-position jitter's MEDIAN (4.65 deg Mars / 2.69 deg Moon). That is not like-for-like, but it is conservative: matching the statistics would only make fp16 look better.
wall_caveat: single short run on a machine with a Modern-Standby / power-cap history; NOT a quotable speedup. Both sides ran back-to-back in one process, so the ratio is the only part with any standing.
